scope: All HostEye use cases UC-01 through UC-40, testing implemented boundaries of partial use cases

comparison_to_previous_run.improved: The old lease-store EIO did not reproduce; current Control Plane heartbeat/bootstrap returned HTTP 200 and granted a lease.
comparison_to_previous_run.new_blocker: The current data plane cannot be built, so Collector health, durable ingest and idempotency cannot complete.
comparison_to_previous_run.ui_measurement_change: A repeatable one-pixel mobile overflow was measured in the rerun.

cases.name: Core service health
cases.actual: 5/6 required endpoints returned HTTP 200. Current-source Collector A was unavailable because no data-plane service could be launched on port 8088.

cases.name: Enrollment, admission, upload lease and durable ingest
cases.actual: Current Control Plane heartbeat and bootstrap returned HTTP 200 and granted a lease. Durable ingest stopped because data_server and worker_server failed to compile (missing ClickHouse Row implementations and an idempotency lifetime error).

cases.name: Dashboard, search, raw detail, alerts and domain APIs
cases.actual: 30/30 authenticated API checks passed against 4,778,445 ClickHouse rows; the latest retained event remained 2026-08-05 15:26:53 and was explicitly marked stale.

cases.name: Endpoint spool, quota and recovery evidence
cases.actual: Quota tests passed 2/2 and both Windows Services run, but the spool holds 213,460 chunks / 10,547,107,368 bytes and last authoritative success is 2026-07-29.

cases.name: Dynamic Config validation and observed signed apply state
cases.actual: Selected-field validation passed 2/2; live API exposed policy, endpoint state and prior applied ACK. A new signed apply/rollback was not executed in this run.

cases.name: ClickHouse outage handling
cases.actual: Isolated Dashboard API returned HTTP 503 with an explicit ClickHouse unavailable message and no fallback data.

cases.name: Desktop and mobile Dashboard navigation
cases.actual: All nine desktop routes rendered without overflow or console errors. At the requested 390x844 viewport, the effective 375 px client showed repeatable 1 px horizontal overflow; Agent Errors returned 404 and some Vietnamese labels were malformed or lacked diacritics.

cases.name: User account lifecycle
cases.actual: Create, login, lock, session revocation and unlock passed; password material is not returned.

cases.name: Role and data-scope authorization
cases.actual: Scoped Viewer allowed the permitted host; outside-host, Alerts and User Management requests returned HTTP 403.

cases.name: Log-loss, fleet monitoring, thresholds and CSV export
cases.actual: Loss summary/hosts/interruptions/alerts/fleet/threshold APIs and authenticated CSV export returned successfully; no generated-event count was fabricated.

cases.name: Full automated regression support
cases.actual: 73 tests passed, 3 optional Docker integration tests skipped, 0 failed.

cases.name: Current-run duplicate chunk idempotency
cases.actual: A lease was obtained, but duplicate upload could not be attempted because the current data plane did not compile or listen on port 8088. Historical idempotency evidence was not counted.

observations.description: Current-source data_server and worker_server fail to compile, so Collector A, durable ingest, ACK and current-run idempotency are unavailable.
HostEyeShipper backlog is 213,460 compressed chunks / 10,547,107,368 bytes; last authoritative upload success remains 2026-07-29.
Dashboard telemetry is stale: 4,778,445 rows are queryable, but the latest retained event is 2026-08-05 15:26:53.
Agent Chunk Errors UI calls a missing Dashboard API route and displays HTTP 404 Route not found.
The requested mobile viewport produced an effective 375 px client width and repeatable 1 px horizontal overflow on all nine routes.
Several Vietnamese headings lack diacritics and the Agent Errors localized error string contains encoding corruption.
